name: Contagion
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).
use: Poison damage over time that spreads to 2–4 enemies within 8 m and stacks twice. Tier 4: a Burn or Overheat detonates it.
note: Combat quickhack. RAM: Tier 2: 5 · Tier 3: 6 · Tier 4: 9 · Tier 5: 12. Tiers: 2 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: upload Contagion on a group first, then Overheat on one of them.

name: Overheat
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).
use: Burn damage over time. Tier 2: re-uploading extends it. Tier 4: melts armor (up to −40%). Tier 5: your attacks add 10% Thermal damage.
note: Combat quickhack. RAM: Tier 1: 3 · Tier 2: 4 · Tier 3: 6 · Tier 4: 7 · Tier 5: 9. Tiers: 1 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: pair it with Contagion to detonate it.

name: Short Circuit
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).
use: Electrical damage, with a bonus against mechs, drones and turrets. Tier 2: +3 s on Control quickhacks. Tier 4: EMP damage over time.
note: Combat quickhack. RAM: Tier 1: 3 · Tier 2: 4 · Tier 3: 5 · Tier 4: 7 · Tier 5: 10. Tiers: 1 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: the cheap hack for robots and drones.

name: Synapse Burnout
where: In The Pickup, copy the malware from the Militech Datashard. Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).
use: Heavy damage: +10% per RAM spent (max +300%; the iconic +400%). Tier 5: boosted during Overclock. Update 2.1 lowered the max; 2.2 fixed the iconic's RAM-cost buff.
note: Combat quickhack. RAM: Tier 3: 10 · Tier 4: 14 · Tier 5: 16. Tiers: 3 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: use it to finish an enemy at low Health.

name: Cripple Movement
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).

note: Control quickhack. RAM: Tier 2: 3 · Tier 3: 4 · Tier 4: 6. Tiers: 2 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: stops enemies who use Sandevistan or Kerenzikov.

name: Cyberware Malfunction
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. note: Control quickhack. RAM: Tier 2: 3 · Tier 3: 4. Tiers: 2 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: against heavily chromed enemies and cyberpsychos.

name: Reboot Optics
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).
use: Resets detection and lowers accuracy. Tier 3: +15% headshot damage. Tier 4: blinds. Tier 5: a headshot kill refunds RAM and spreads it.
note: Control quickhack. RAM: Tier 1: 2 · Tier 3: 5 · Tier 4: 7. Tiers: 1 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: use it before you are spotted to stay hidden.

name: Weapon Glitch
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. Enemy netrunners drop it and Breach Protocol datamines give it too. Iconic version: Sammy Taylor, EBM Petrochem Stadium (Phantom Liberty).

note: Control quickhack. RAM: Tier 2: 3 · Tier 3: 4 · Tier 4: 6. Tiers: 2 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: against gunmen pinning you down.

name: Bait
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. note: Covert quickhack. RAM: Tier 1: 2 · Tier 2: 3 · Tier 4: 4 · iconic: 3. Tiers: 1 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: pull them apart one at a time for takedowns.

name: Memory Wipe
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. note: Covert quickhack. RAM: Tier 3: 8 · Tier 4: 10 · Tier 5: 32. Tiers: 3 to 5, plus the iconic. Tip: Tier 5 costs 32 RAM; keep it for escapes.

name: Ping
where: Free in The Gift (Yoko Tsuru, Kabuki), during The Rescue. name: Request Backup

name: Sonic Shock
where: Netrunner vendors (the hack and its crafting spec): Yoko Tsuru (Kabuki), Chang Hoon Nam (Japantown), Nix (Little China) and the Netrunner vendors in Coastview, Japantown and Vista del Rey. note: Ultimate quickhack. RAM: 14. Tiers: 3. The RAM cost rises with each spread; paying in Health halves it.
